<infobox theme="IU-media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="author"><label>Author(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="editor"><label>Editor(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="illustrator"><label>Illustrator(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="artist"><label>Artist(s)</label></data>			
        <data source="performer"><label>Performer(s)</label></data>			
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Publication information</header>
        <data source="publisher"><label>Publisher</label></data>	
        <data source="release date"><label>Release date</label></data>	
        <data source="media type"><label>Type</label></data>	
        <data source="pages"><label>Pages</label></data>
        <data source="published in"><label>Published in</label></data>	     
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="genre"><label>Genre</label></data>			
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:IU_media|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
